hero.title: Objects with quiet pull.
hero.body: Sculptural ceramics, soft goods and personal pieces with restraint.
hero.imageAlt: Luxury boutique display with ceramics and accessories

products.title: The current edit
products.body: Small runs, honest materials, no filler.
products.imageAlt: Still life of luxury home objects and accessories

lookbook.title: Tactile pieces that sit quietly together.
lookbook.body: Ivory clay, smoked glass, warm brass and deep oxblood leather are chosen to layer without shouting.
lookbook.imageAlt: Curated homeware still life with candle, ceramic vase, throw and oxblood leather pouch

journal.title: Built around feeling, not trends.
journal.body: Every object is chosen for proportion, texture and the way it sits with other things. The shop stays intentionally narrow so the collection can breathe.

shopCta.title: Need a considered gift?
shopCta.body: We wrap orders in tissue and ribbon, add a note, and can help choose pieces for a room or recipient.

gifting.title: Wrapped with the same care as the object.
gifting.body: Choose a note, tell us the date, and we will prepare the order from our Marylebone studio for collection or UK delivery.
gifting.imageAlt: Ceramic homeware being wrapped in tissue paper with ribbon on a boutique worktable

about.title: A small London shop for enduring materials.
about.body: Aurea Objects works with independent makers, mills and small workshops across the UK and Europe. The collection is edited slowly, with repairs, refills and longevity in mind.
about.imageAlt: Luxury home objects arranged on a pale plinth

visit.title: Visit by appointment or collect in person.
visit.body: Book a quiet appointment for gifting, styling or sourcing pieces for a room.

returns.title: Returns
returns.body: Unused items can be returned within 14 days. Custom sourcing and personal orders are handled case by case.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: We only use your details to reply to enquiries, process orders and send notes you have chosen to receive.

footer.newsletterBody: Seasonal arrivals, studio visits and object stories.
footer.serviceBody: UK delivery from GBP 6. Complimentary Marylebone collection and careful gift wrapping available.
